name: VS-Splat Voxel Selection
definition: A voxel selection approach that predicts confidence scores via Gumbel-Sigmoid and uses them to refine opacity values.
summary: VS-Splat Voxel Selection is a learnable, differentiable mechanism that replaces static opacity thresholding with a Gumbel-Sigmoid confidence process to select relevant 3D voxels for Gaussian Splatting.
